proposed_json_schema.title: Proposed same-matrix input capsule; cross-field checks are additionally required

capture_boundary.const: sealed ordered raw augmented system before filtering; identical full input and schedule for every selector

input_capsule.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; residue values decimal strings to avoid JSON numeric precision loss; byte hash is authoritative. Sorted unique sparse column indices, nonzero canonical residues, contiguous ordered row_index, explicit zero rows, and immutable column order including target are mandatory. Bind raw bytes and separately version canonicalization. Store whole-capsule SHA256 plus rows/RHS semantic hashes; never infer equality from seed alone.
cross_field_checks: Odd prime modulus fits u64 and chosen supported archive/curve regime; non-prime/composite or unsupported widths refused. Bind primality evidence rather than assuming field arithmetic.
All coefficients and RHS in [0,r), entries nonzero, column bounds valid and target index within declared columns; no silent deduplication, reordering, dropped rows or signed conversion.
Every arm verifies identical capsule SHA, column order, modulus, complete raw rows and common feed schedule before any preprocessing.

Bind exact CurveSpec and source recipe/manifests/shards/signed factor-base order, subgroup/cofactor/generator/target and workload, plus group-equation validation receipts. Separate asserted group order from proved group order.

For complete useful_rank transcripts require transcript_complete=true, zero invalid rows and exact retained receipts; group validation needs exact base/workload context. Do not treat transcript as self-authenticating.
Archive audit supports 1..4096 base columns plus target; retain explicit base versus augmented rank. Receipt cap is 8 MiB. Truncated transcripts are not full-rank or same-matrix evidence.

selector_contract.reference: incremental-gauss on complete sealed augmented system, independently verified rank/pivots and solution. Do not stop reading at first full rank: validate all raw equations and retain common prefix acceptance separately.
selector_contract.completion: All selectors are FullRank mode; no known-log shortcut or TargetResidual comparison. Complete sealed raw system must remain available even where a wrapper stops early.
selector_contract.configuration: Bind serialized exact effective FilterOptions/SparseSolveOptions, block dimensions, modulus, build/dependencies, seed rule and attempts. Filtered uses CADO preset; unfiltered preserves raw input until solver folding. Core transformations/maps are artifacts, never replacements for raw capsule.
comparison_design: sparse-cado versus filter+wiedemann: alias A/A with identical build/input/seed; exact outputs and counter/report identities expected; difference invalidates alias/telemetry check.
filter+wiedemann versus wiedemann, and filter+lanczos versus lanczos: filter treatment comparisons with same core and fixed other factors.
filter+wiedemann versus filter+lanczos, and wiedemann versus lanczos: core solver-package comparisons; solver-specific internals are part of treatment, not isolated primitive-cost claims.
Gaussian versus sparse: whole solver-package comparison; reconcile work-unit definitions before any numeric work ratio.

oracle_and_failure_contract.required: Independent exact coefficient rank and augmented rank transcript over bound field, pivot/row-operation certificate and full equation verification. Rank must equal declared column count for unique solution comparison; rank(A|b)>rank(A) is inconsistent.
oracle_and_failure_contract.planted_solution: May calibrate positive controls only; Ax=b against a planted vector is not a full-rank certificate.
oracle_and_failure_contract.sparse_two_seed: Record both wrapper attempts, seeds, outcomes, returned vectors and reports, including failures/retries. Equal successful vectors and equation checks do not replace the rank oracle.
oracle_and_failure_contract.rules: No failure is silently dropped or interpreted as mathematical rejection. Singular consistent inputs compare solution-space correctness, not a unique vector; rank-deficient and inconsistent controls must be handled explicitly. Full-rank oracle error or missing evidence invalidates the instance comparison.

required_per_attempt: all SparseSolveReport fields including nested Wiedemann/Lanczos report
row/column maps and reconstruction information where exposed; otherwise explicit missing interface
native counters even if not charged
status, attempt number, elapsed clock validity, rusage/peak RSS and artifacts by hash
telemetry_retention.wrapper_rule: Retain every returned attempt report before aggregation; current row_ops-only wrapper accumulation is insufficient. Preserve conversion and repeated/failed attempt work. Do not count an extra standalone filter pass as part of one solve without declaring it.

complete report.row_ops plus wrapper input-conversion/attempt accounting

metrics_and_units.limitation: Not separate field multiply/add counters; excludes small-block approximant/Lanczos arithmetic and dense-column scans. Do not call it complete arithmetic cost or compare directly to Gaussian work if definitions differ.

metrics_and_units.limitation: No field/group/GAE conversion or end-to-end speedup without separately frozen calibrated whole-system accounting.

controls.aa: Run alias pair with identical canonical capsule/options/seeds; second independent read/serialization validates round trip. For stochastic variability, freeze independent seed repeats without changing matrices. Separate encoding/order nuisance test with invertible mapping and original-equation verification; never mix it with selector treatment.
controls.positive: Small odd-prime systems with independently certified full rank and planted solution, passed through same capture/import/selector path. Include controlled dependencies, singleton, duplicate and filter reconstruction cases.
controls.negative: Rank-deficient consistent and provably inconsistent fixtures through same path. Null relation-shaped matrices matched to actual dimensions,density,row-weight law; column-frequency law recorded and matched if inferential target requires it. Exact generator/distribution, RHS rule and independent oracle must be pinned; currently absent.
controls.no_fake_controls: Existing owner-held studies or pure GF(2) kernel matrices are not these controls. A failed positive control invalidates comparison; no-support conclusion forbidden.
